title: Gourmet Popcorn 3 Ways - White Cheddar Explosion
body:
Three incredible popcorn flavors that will make you forget movie theater popcorn exists. The white cheddar is absolutely sinful.

Ingredients:
- 1 cup popcorn kernels
- 1/2 cup white cheddar powder
- 2 tbsp truffle oil
- 1/4 cup parmesan
- Rosemary
- Cayenne pepper

Steps:
1. Pop kernels in hot oil
2. Divide into three bowls
3. Toss with white cheddar powder
4. Drizzle truffle oil on second
5. Season third with cayenne and parmesan
6. Serve immediately
summary: Three incredible gourmet popcorn flavors. The white cheddar is absolutely sinful.
